assumptions: Explicit hypothetical FY2027 GAAP diluted-EPS/P-E sensitivity, not consensus, forecast, observed multiple, or fair-value estimate. FY27 H1 reported GAAP diluted EPS is $4.85. Q3 revenue guidance is $108bn +/-2%, 74% GAAP GM +/-50bp, $9.2bn GAAP opex and 16-18% FY tax. Bear $9.50 assumes Q3 is near the low guidance/margin band and Q4 demand or mix normalizes; base $10.10 assumes Q3 guidance is achieved and Q4 sustains broadly Q3-level earnings; bull $10.70 assumes high-end Q3 and continued demand/margin resilience in Q4. Multiples 19x/22x/25x are deliberately unweighted stress assumptions.
qualification: All EPS and P/E inputs are analyst assumptions, not observed multiples or consensus. Prices are conditional sensitivities, not forecasts, probabilities or executable quotes. The earnings period differs from the research horizon; assumption and share-basis suitability require review.
